info.title: Shopee QRIS Gateway API
info.description: Create QRIS payments with unique amounts, track their status, and receive signed webhook events. Amounts are whole Indonesian rupiah (IDR). API requests require X-API-Key. Manually injected Shopee sessions are managed by the operator; no login or OTP endpoints are exposed.

tags.name: Transactions
tags.description: Persisted QRIS payment requests and settlement status.

tags.name: Shopee
tags.description: Local credential validity and recent provider feed health.

get.description: A successful response does not assert PostgreSQL connectivity or Shopee session health.

post.description: Adds a unique code from the inclusive UNIQUE_CODE_MIN through UNIQUE_CODE_MAX environment range (defaults 1 through 999) to the requested amount. Pay exactly total_amount using the returned QRIS payload. Payable amounts are reserved in PostgreSQL across API instances, including collisions between different base amounts. Repeating the same transaction_id with identical amount and webhook_url returns the existing payment, including during a Shopee outage. Changing those details or merchant scope returns 409. New payments require a recent complete Shopee feed scan (login_state.state = ready). The default payment window is 15 minutes. Expiration is finalized after a two minute feed delay allowance and a successful complete scan; provider outages or incomplete scans leave payments pending. The QRIS itself does not enforce this deadline at Shopee.

The gateway sends transaction.paid or transaction.expired, with at least once delivery. Deduplicate by event_id. Verify X-Webhook-Signature as sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256> using WEBHOOK_SECRET over X-Webhook-Timestamp + '.' + the exact raw request body bytes. Use a constant time comparison and reject stale timestamps (for example, older than five minutes). The timestamp and signature refresh on each attempt; event_id stays stable. The API key is never sent. Return 2xx after persisting the event. Non-2xx responses, timeouts, and transport failures retry indefinitely with exponential backoff capped at 2560 seconds. Redirects are not followed.

parameters.name: X-Webhook-ID
parameters.description: Stable event UUID, also included as event_id in the body.

parameters.name: X-Webhook-Timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp in seconds for this delivery attempt.

parameters.name: X-Webhook-Signature
parameters.description: HMAC-SHA256 signature of timestamp + '.' + raw body.

2XX.description: The website persisted the event. Any 2xx response acknowledges delivery.

get.description: Returns the original transaction_id and payment details together with current login health. This endpoint reads the database and does not make a live Shopee request.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The transaction_id supplied when creating the payment.

get.summary: Check Shopee login and feed health
get.description: Reads the injected session locally and reports the last background feed check. authenticated alone does not guarantee provider acceptance. Only state=ready indicates a recent successful complete feed scan. This endpoint returns 200 even when the session is missing, expired, or degraded.

200.description: Current local login validity and feed state.

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description: Enter the gateway API_KEY. Swagger UI keeps it in memory for this page; it is not embedded in the docs or saved across reloads.

RequestID.description: Request identifier for correlating gateway logs.

transaction_id.description: Globally unique client transaction ID. Maximum 128 UTF-8 bytes; no control characters or surrounding whitespace.

amount.description: Base transaction amount in whole IDR, before the unique code is added.

webhook_url.description: HTTP(S) URL whose exact scheme, host, and port are listed in WEBHOOK_ALLOWED_ORIGINS. No embedded credentials or fragment. HTTPS is recommended.

total_amount.description: amount + unique_code. The buyer must pay this exact whole IDR amount.

qris.description: Dynamic EMVCo QRIS payload encoding total_amount. Render it as a QR code on your website.

status.description: paid requires a completed Shopee transaction matching the amount and time window. expired means no matching successful payment was found after the deadline and feed delay allowance; it does not identify a failed individual payment attempt.

provider_transaction_id.description: Shopee transaction ID, present only for a matched paid payment.

authenticated.description: Local session credential validity, accounting for known provider authentication rejection.

last_checked_at.description: Last completed background provider request. Null before a check or after session replacement.

last_successful_at.description: Last successful provider request, which may have been truncated. Use state=ready to require a complete scan. Null before success or after session replacement.

event_id.description: Stable across retries. Use this value to deduplicate deliveries.

TransactionCreated.description: A new payment was persisted and its amount reserved.

TransactionFound.description: The persisted payment, including an identical creation retry.

BadRequest.description: Malformed JSON or invalid transaction fields.

Unauthorized.description: X-API-Key is missing or invalid. Login health is not included.

NotFound.description: The requested transaction does not exist.

Conflict.description: The transaction ID exists with different details, or all candidate payable amounts in the configured unique code range are reserved.

BodyTooLarge.description: The request exceeds the 16384 byte body limit.

InternalError.description: Unexpected server error. Details are logged; the response uses a generic message.

SessionUnavailable.description: Shopee login/feed health is not ready for a new payment.
